content.short: DreamOS is a Web3-native operating system on Mantle that radically simplifies crypto by presenting DeFi through a familiar OS interface.
content.description: DreamOS reimagines the way users interact with blockchain technology by presenting Web3 through an intuitive operating system metaphor. Instead of navigating between fragmented dApps, users manage wallets, swap tokens, access DeFi protocols, and explore NFTs from a unified desktop-like environment. By abstracting seed phrases, gas fees, and complex transaction flows behind familiar UX patterns, DreamOS targets mainstream adoption of the Mantle ecosystem. The project has received Mantle EcoFund support and is positioned as a key onboarding tool for non-crypto-native users.
content.meta: DreamOS is a Web3-native OS on Mantle that simplifies DeFi with a familiar operating system experience. Discover DreamOS on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
